description: This file contains implementation related to security certificates management, including functions for reading, processing, and exposing certificate data via a device management interface. It interacts with OpenSSL to handle X509 certificates, manages certificate paths, and provides methods for retrieving certificate details such as serial number, issuer, validity period, subject, and signature algorithm.

classes.name: certificate_profile
classes.description: Structure holding a certificate's path and its X509 certificate object.

methods.name: void init_certificate(char * path,X509 * cert,struct certificate_profile * certprofile)
methods.description: Initializes a certificate profile with a given path and X509 certificate.

methods.name: char * get_certificate_sig_alg(int sig_nid)
methods.description: Returns the signature algorithm name for a given signature NID.

methods.name: char * generate_serial_number(const char * text,int length)
methods.description: Generates a hexadecimal serial number string from binary data.

methods.name: int fill_certificate_paths(const char * dir_path,int * cidx)
methods.description: Populates the certificate paths array with certificate files from a directory.

methods.name: int get_certificate_paths(void)
methods.description: Retrieves and populates certificate file paths from system or specified directories.

methods.name: int browseSecurityCertificateInst(struct dmctx * dmctx,DMNODE * parent_node,void * prev_data,char * prev_instance)
methods.description: Browses and loads certificate files, creating instances for each valid certificate.

methods.name: int get_Security_CertificateNumberOfEntries(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the number of security certificate entries.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_LastModif(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets the last modification time of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_SerialNumber(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_Issuer(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the issuer name of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_NotBefore(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets the not-before (valid from) date of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_NotAfter(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets the not-after (valid to) date of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_Subject(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the subject name of a certificate.

methods.name: int get_SecurityCertificate_SignatureAlgorithm(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the signature algorithm used for the certificate.
